sn3.19:2.3: This gives an idea of the prosperity of Sāvatthī in those days.
sn3.19:2.7: Hemp (_sāṇa_) is known for cloth, but not as an intoxicant.
sn3.19:2.9: Compare the splendid chariot of the brahmin Jānussoṇi ([sn45.4:1.3]()).
sn3.19:8.3: BB’s “noble” is unfortunate here: it is nisabha, chief bull, not ariya.
